source_conversation.content: Hi, I am going away from December 1 to December 8 and I would like Gmail on my PC to send an automatic reply to people who email me while I am gone. Is it possible to make the reply go only to people in my contacts? If so, how do I set that up?

sections.text: On a computer, in Gmail: 1. Open Gmail on your computer. 2. At the top right, click the Settings icon, then click 'See all settings.' 3. On the 'General' tab, scroll to the 'Vacation responder' section. 4. Select 'Vacation responder on.' 5. Enter a date range, a subject, and a message. 6. Optional: To send replies only to your contacts, check the box below the message. 7. At the bottom of the page, click 'Save Changes.'
Your automatic reply starts at 12:00 AM on the start date and ends at 11:59 PM on the end date, unless you end it earlier.

sections.text: On a computer, in Gmail: 1. Open Gmail on your computer. 2. In the left sidebar, next to 'Labels', click the 'Create new label' icon. 3. Enter a name for the label. 4. Optional: To nest it under another label, check 'Nest label under' and choose the parent label. 5. Click 'Create'.
